read_proto_file: read a serialized protobuf file from disk and return its raw bytes
write_proto_file: write serialized protobuf bytes to a file on disk
read_binary_config: read a binary configuration file relative to the module root directory
write_serialized_data: write arbitrary serialized binary data to a file in the module directory
inspect_root_dir: inspect the _ROOT_DIR variable to find the module's base directory path
